scenes.narration: Something happened that no one saw coming: the collapse of a fund that never actually invested a single dollar.
To understand why, you need to know how it started, three years earlier, with a single spreadsheet and a promise of guaranteed returns.
scenes.assetCredit: Photo by Example Contributor on Pexels

scenes.narration: What came next changed everything, as new investor money quietly paid off old investors, and the numbers on paper kept climbing.
scenes.assetCredit: Video by Example Contributor on Pexels

scenes.narration: "We had no idea," one investor later said. "Everything looked completely legitimate."
